working_on.feature: Focus Mode & Live DC Telemetry Navigation Tracker
working_on.task: Completed all 6 phases, performance audit fixes, test suites verification, and GitHub repository sync
working_on.notes: All 6 Focus Mode phases completed & verified. Performance audit performed and 7/7 issues resolved (GPS leak, Android 14 FGS, GC churn, duplicate scroll, touch drag metrics, TTS audio ducking, coroutine protection). APK built and verified on device with live logs, and changes committed & pushed to origin/main.

recent_changes.description: Committed and pushed full Focus Mode, Live Telemetry, Audit fixes, and Nearby auto-scroll codebase to GitHub repository (skul9x/EV-Plus:main)

Applied Fix All for Performance Audit: GPS listener & Coroutine cleanup in FocusModeForegroundService, Android 14 FGS permission fallback, HERE EV raw filtering to cut GC churn, duplicate scroll animation prevention, display metrics touch caching, and atomic TTS audio ducking counter.
Completed Phase 01 to Phase 06 of Focus Mode & Live Telemetry subsystem

errors_encountered.error: Potential GPS listener leak when FocusModeForegroundService receives ACTION_START multiple times
errors_encountered.solution: Added explicit locationService?.stopLocationUpdates() and stateCollectionJob?.cancel() before reallocating

errors_encountered.error: Android 14 SecurityException when starting FGS with FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_LOCATION without runtime permission
errors_encountered.solution: Checked permission dynamically and fell back to FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_DATA_SYNC with try-catch wrapper

errors_encountered.error: Heavy Garbage Collection churn from mapping 50 HERE EV stations during 5s polling intervals
errors_encountered.solution: Optimized HereEvApiClient.fetchStationById to filter on raw HereEvStation models first before domain mapping

decisions_made.decision: Hybrid 2-Tier Architecture for Live DC Telemetry
decisions_made.reason: Tier 1 queries HERE EV API (OAuth 1.0a HMAC-SHA256 direct from VinFast credentials) without driver login, falling back to Tier 2 EVCS
Saves cellular radio power and battery when far away (>3km: 15s, 1.5-3km: 10s) and provides near real-time updates when approaching (<1.5km: 5s)

decisions_made.decision: System Alert Window Overlay (TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY) with Notification Fallback
decisions_made.reason: Allows real-time station availability capsule to float on top of Google Maps navigation while seamlessly falling back to Foreground Notification if overlay permission is denied
